answer: A liveness pulse makes each identity prove it is still alive: every agent must periodically submit a small proof-of-work heartbeat tied to its recent on-chain activity, and identities that miss the pulse lose their mining seat. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge - it can mine only a small quota until its pulse history proves consistent, so a Sybil farm must keep thousands of fake identities pulsing forever, paying compute for each one. Like a sonnet, the rule is strict in form but leaves the content free: the cost is real, repeated, and tied to one identity, so cheap copies buy no advantage.
